intended_behavior: Enhance this function to extract token usage and cost information from the litellm completion responses or internal state, and provide proactive warnings to the user about approaching or exceeding usage budgets or costs. This should help prevent unexpected high bills while preserving streaming code generation functionality.

Extend the respond function to proactively display token usage and cost information to the user during the session, not only after budget exceed exceptions occur. Maintain existing budget handling, error catching, and fallback logic.
